title: Image informativeness in disaster posts: availability-aware multimodal fusion
target: Original per-event TSV image_info annotation; informative=1, not_informative=0. JSON mirror labels are audited but not used as targets.
split: StratifiedGroupKFold(5, shuffle=True, random_state=42): fold 0 test, fold 1 validation, remaining folds training. Groups join tweet ID, identical decoded image pixels, and identical cleaned text of at least 20 characters.
image_features: Frozen torchvision ResNet18 IMAGENET1K_V1, official transforms, 512 features
text_features: Training-only TF-IDF unigrams and bigrams, max_features=20000, min_df=2, sublinear_tf=True; training-only TruncatedSVD(256), random_state=42
derived_baseline: Mean of text and image probabilities, with available-modality fallback
checkpoint: Highest validation macro-F1; earliest checkpoint on ties; no test-based selection
primary_comparison: gated versus concat_drop, clean test macro-F1
statistics: Seed-ensemble predictions, paired group bootstrap confidence intervals and group permutation test. Secondary robustness comparisons use Holm correction.
curves: Test curves evaluated retrospectively only after checkpoint selection is locked
scope: One dataset. No claim of novel research state of the art or universal accuracy superiority. Raw encoder is pretrained; fusion algorithms and training loops are implemented directly in PyTorch.
